程序包 com.ta.recruitment.model

类 DataStore

java.lang.Object
com.ta.recruitment.model.DataStore
public class DataStore extends Object
Singleton in-memory data store with JSON file persistence.

All data is loaded from WEB-INF/data/ on first initialisation via init(String) and flushed back to disk after every mutating operation. Collections are kept in memory for fast access; the class is thread-safe on write paths that are declared synchronized.
